definitions.gloss: to sink to; to stoop to; to degrade oneself to
definitions.explanation: to fall to a lower status, role, or condition that is considered shameful

examples.japanese: ⟦{詐欺師|さぎし}→詐欺師：10176_sagishi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{成|な}り{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: He sank to becoming a con artist.

examples.japanese: ⟦{犯罪者|はんざいしゃ}→犯罪者：19219_hanzaisha⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{成|な}り{下|さ}がる⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{思|おも}わなかった→思う：00492_omou⟧。
examples.english: I never thought he would stoop to becoming a criminal.

examples.japanese: ⟦かつて→かつて：10303_katsute⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{英雄|えいゆう}→英雄：14117_eiyuu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{乞食|こじき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{成|な}り{下|さ}がった。
examples.english: The former hero was reduced to begging.

notes:
TRANSITIVITY:
Intransitive (⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧)

USAGE:
- 〜⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{成|な}り{下|さ}がる (to sink to becoming ~)
Strongly negative connotation. Implies a shameful fall from a better state. The destination is always something considered degrading or dishonorable.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{成|な}り{上|あ}がる→成り上がる：08205_nariagaru⟧ (to rise in status - opposite direction, but also often negative as "parvenu")
- {落|お}ちぶれる (to come down in the world - similar but less focused on moral degradation)

cross_references.label: to rise in status; to climb the social ladder
